article.story: HIGHLAND HEIGHTS, Ky. -- — Donovan Rakotonanahary scored 17 points as Northern Kentucky beat Division III's Berea 93-41 on Thursday night . Rakotonanahary also had three steals for the Norse (3-3). B.J. Davis-Ray scored 16 points on 7-for-11 shooting with three steals. Noah Pagotto had 14 points and shot 3 of 5 from the field and 8 of 9 from the free-throw line. Dominique Anthony led the Mountaineers with seven points. Up next: Northern Kentucky hosts Georgia Southern in its next matchup on Monday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
